paper.title: Algorithm 875: DSDP5, software for semidefinite programming

stack: C (TOMS 875 archive: src/, include/, examples/, bin/ with the shipped reference log bin/output.theta and input bin/graph1)

claim.text: theta graph1 (Lovasz theta SDP of the 6-node, 8-edge graph shipped as bin/graph1): the DD Objective of the last iteration, as a magnitude, is 3.00000012 (shipped reference log bin/output.theta, iteration 4). Absolute tolerance 1e-5.

attempt: Reproduced with a build-only change to the build command. The authors' documented route (make.include as shipped, DSDPROOT set in the environment, make all) builds libdsdp.a and fails at the first link: 'cannot find -lg2c' (make.include lists the obsolete f2c runtime in LAPACKBLAS; it is absent on this host). The same unedited make.include is used with the library list overridden on the make command line (LAPACKBLAS='-llapack -lblas -lm') and only the library and examples targets built (the matlab step needs mex and is skipped; it is not part of the claim). Three manifests prove no source or makefile was touched (verify_sources record: build-only). theta graph1 then prints the same log as the shipped reference, byte for byte (diff: identical), so the DD objective is -3.00000012 in both passes, magnitude 3.00000012, difference 0 against tol 1e-5.

original_attempt.reason: make all (documented route): libdsdp.a builds; the first example link fails with '/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lg2c' (make.include LAPACKBLAS = -llapack -lblas -lg2c -lm). The matlab target (dsdp) then fails with exit 127 because mex is absent. make exits 2.

build_commands: cd /work/build && DSDPROOT=/work/build make LAPACKBLAS='-llapack -lblas -lm' dsdplibrary example
